title: Multiple Stopping and Exercise Boundaries for American Put Options
abstract: arXiv:2610.30637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This article studies a finite-horizon American put option with up to $m$ exercise rights under the risk-neutral Black--Scholes model, where consecutive exercises must be separated by a prescribed refractory period $\delta>0$ and unused rights may expire. For each number of remaining rights, we show that optimal exercise is characterized by a single exercise boundary and that these boundaries are ordered by the number of remaining rights. We prove optimality of the first boundary-hitting time and establish local Lipschitz continuity of the exercise boundaries within each open deadline strip. Away from the deadlines, we derive smooth fit, the associated quasi-variational inequality and free-boundary formulation, an early-exercise-premium representation, recursive Volterra-type boundary equations, and a verification theorem. translated_title: 美式看跌期权的多次停时与行权边界
translated_abstract: 本文在风险中性 Black–Scholes 模型下研究了有限期限、最多拥有 $m$ 个行权权利的美式看跌期权，其中相邻两次行权必须间隔一段给定的不应期 $\delta>0$，且未使用的权利可能过期失效。对于每个剩余权利数量，我们证明最优行权由单一行权边界刻画，并且这些边界按剩余权利的数量排序。我们证明了首次触及边界的停时是最优的，并在每个开放的截止期限条带内建立了行权边界的局部 Lipschitz 连续性。在远离截止期限的区域，我们推导了光滑粘合条件、相应的拟变分不等式与自由边界表述、提前行权溢价表示、递归 Volterra 型边界方程以及验证定理。我们还将该递归表述推广到独立的随机终止时间情形，从而允许外生的终（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文在带不应期约束的 Black–Scholes 模型下，证明多次行权美式看跌期权的最优行权由按剩余权利数排序的行权边界刻画，并建立了光滑粘合条件、拟变分不等式、提前行权溢价表示、递归 Volterra 型边界方程与验证定理等完整的自由边界分析框架。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes optimal multiple exercise of finite-horizon American put options with refractory periods in the Black–Scholes model via exercise boundaries ordered by the number of remaining rights, and establishes smooth fit, quasi-variational inequalities, early-exercise-premium representations, recursive Volterra-type boundary equations, and a verification theorem.
